FIELD NOTES / RETURN / 2025

NO CLEAN
RESTART.
JUST THE
RECORD.

The return is interesting precisely because it was not a perfect restart. The early problems stayed in the report and the later selection grew out of them.

01

Curiosity came first

The mixed seed run was used to see what would actually emerge rather than to force a predetermined result.

02

The first attempt was small

23 seeds were started and only three early plants appeared. Winter air and heat became part of the real conditions.

03

Variation became the subject

As more plants appeared the differences became impossible to ignore. One unusual plant became number 18 in the Zwergenbattle 2025.

04

Names stayed provisional

Possible identities such as Gelato, Skunk, Purple Tangie and Cali Orange were treated as possibilities rather than fixed labels.
